packages.name: SharedFiles
packages.description: The folder for your own GameCube discs and extracted assets, installed with the Mario, Olimar and Melee mods. The discs are optional: the mods work without them. No code.

packages.name: Mario
packages.description: Mario with FLUDD as a survivor. Play with generic shapes; your own Sunshine assets are optional. No game content included. Offline and friends-only.

packages.name: Olimar
packages.description: Olimar, Pikmin and Ship Repair. Olimar plays with stand-ins and optional Pikmin assets; Ship Repair needs the Pikmin and Pikmin 2 discs on every player's machine. No game content included. Offline and friends-only.

packages.name: Melee
packages.description: Samus and Yoshi as survivors. Play with generic fighters and projectiles; your own Melee assets are optional. No game content included. Offline and friends-only.
